title: Atlas Ingine Persona & Mech-Interp Spec (v1, frozen)
description: Declarative specification for mech-interp probe interventions and validated/product persona profiles in atlas-ingine (Inkling-2-Mini). Aligned with neuropedia PERSONA-OPUS.md and KIT-LOG.md (Verified Ledger kit log). Every model-modifying entry carries a provenance record; entries without full provenance, with status='probe', with discovery-only evidence, or mismatched model_binding downgrade to probe and load only under --persona-probe-mode. Coordinate d_2027, gradient-trained adapters, sealed/heldout donors, and refusal-linked units (--refusal-map) are unconditionally rejected.

spec_metadata.description: Traceability header for this spec file. The server also computes spec_sha256 over the raw spec file bytes at load time and attaches it to response metadata.

author.description: Author or agent id that generated this spec.

profiles_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of canonicalised 'profiles' JSON; verified at load if present.

default_profile.description: Profile applied when a request omits 'persona'. MUST be 'none' unless it names a 'product' profile (outside --persona-probe-mode). 'none' uses the unhooked bit-identical fast path.

profiles.description: Named persona or probe profiles selectable per request via the 'persona' field in /v1/chat/completions.

NoOpCheck.description: Standing exact-0.0 no-op check passed on target hardware through the exact fused path across all six required visits: prelude (3), loop entry (6), mid pass-0 (10), first re-entry / loop_msg boundary (18), late pass-1 (29), and coda (44).

flag.description: Exact intervention/no-op flag or mode tested (e.g. 'force_already_selected_g1', 'neuron_affine_1_0', 'self_replay_recompute', 'self_replay_copy', 'depth_replace_self_both', 'slot_permute_id', 'ablate_null').

fused_path.description: Exact fused kernel path executed during the no-op check (e.g. 'dense::router_hooked+prefill::moe_topk_hooked').

hardware.description: Hardware on which exact 0.0 was verified (e.g. 'Tesla V100-PCIE-32GB sm_70', 'RTX 3090 sm_86', 'RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell sm_120a').

visits.description: Chronological visits verified at exact 0.0; must contain at least {3, 6, 10, 18, 29, 44} (prelude, loop entry, mid pass-0, re-entry, late pass-1, coda).

MeasuredEffect.description: Measured effect with noise floor beside it. Missing floor_kind or value <= floor downgrades the entry to probe.

floor_kind.description: Noise floor estimator kind; required for validated/product.

floor_n.description: Sample count used to estimate the noise floor.

engine.description: Engine identifier and commit where effect was measured (captures from different engines are not pooled).

weights_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the model weights file/manifest where effect was measured.

RefusalCheck.description: Private refusal-set verification record. Required with passed=true for validated and product status.

Origin.description: Character and source text this element was fitted from.

Provenance.description: Per-element provenance record aligned with neuropedia KIT-LOG.md (Verified Ledger kit log). Required for every model-modifying entry outside --persona-probe-mode.

purpose.description: (1) What this intervention is for ('written for' in KIT-LOG).

experiment.description: (2a) Registered experiment or run identifier that validated this entry.

evidence_file.description: (2b) Path to the validating evidence artifact.

evidence_split.description: Split on which evidence was measured. 'validated' and 'product' require 'confirmation'; 'discovery' stays 'probe'.

status.description: (5) Lifecycle status. 'probe' entries load only when --persona-probe-mode is enabled.

reaches.description: Prompt scope/trigger this element reaches (mirrors KIT-LOG 'reaches'). Required for validated/product.

origin.description: Which character and source text the element was fitted from. Required for validated/product.

refusal_checked.description: Private refusal-set check result. Required with passed=true for validated/product.

ModelBinding.description: Exact model weights, quantisation, engine commit, prompt renderer, and chat_template.jinja SHA-256 the profile was validated on. Loading on any mismatching model/quant/commit/renderer/template downgrades the whole profile to 'probe'.

prompt_renderer.description: Canonical prompt renderer / chat-switch contract under which the profile was validated (e.g. 'ingine_chat_format_v1', 'chat_template_jinja:reasoning_effort=none').

chat_template_sha256.description: SHA-256 of chat_template.jinja under which the profile was validated.

CompositionEvidence.description: Required whenever a validated/product profile contains more than one model-modifying intervention: proves the combined profile passed its own no-op and measured-effect check.

OwnerGrade.description: Owner blind-grade record certifying a product character (an automatic judge cannot certify 'alive').

ReasoningCheck.description: Hard-reasoning benchmark with the profile active vs plain baseline; required for product status.

LeakageCheck.description: Cross-request cache-hit isolation verification (neutral B alone vs after A with shared prefix, both orders, cache-hit and forced-recompute paths).

DonorRef.description: Reference to a train-split donor capture for route_replay or depth_replace. Sealed/heldout/confirmation splits and inline sealed token ids are unconditionally rejected.

category.description: Effective profile status is min(category, min over intervention statuses, downgrades from model_binding/composition_evidence/evidence_split).

persona_fingerprint.description: Optional expected SHA-256 of canonicalised profile JSON (excluding persona_fingerprint itself); computed and verified by the server at load time and used to isolate KV/checkpoint/parked caches.

id.description: Unique element identifier within the profile (mirrors KIT-LOG 'id').

type.description: Probe/diagnostic hooks: router_ablate, router_force, router_slot_permute, route_replay, neuron_affine, depth_replace, residual_steer. Read-only taps: tap_expert (3a), tap_routing. Measured closed-form low-rank fits (Rungs 5-6): router_lowrank_fit, expert_down_lowrank_fit.

role.description: Constant pushes (router_ablate, router_force, router_slot_permute, route_replay, neuron_affine, depth_replace, residual_steer) are probes, never product.

fit_method.description: Required for router_lowrank_fit and expert_down_lowrank_fit. Gradient-trained character adapters ('trained') are forbidden by owner rule.

physical_block.description: Physical block index (0..23). Cross-checked against VISITS[visit].layer when visit >= 0; load fails on mismatch.

loop_pass.description: Loop pass index (0..2). Cross-checked against VISITS[visit].pass when visit >= 0; load fails on mismatch.

src_idx.description: Optional source index for depth_replace (-1 = all sources).

donor.description: Required for route_replay and depth_replace in spec files: manifest_sha256 + row_id + split='train' + raw_order=true.

vector.description: Dense H=2304 residual steering vector (probe only). Coordinate 2027 MUST be 0.0.

sparse_vector.description: Sparse coordinate->value map for residual_steer (probe only). Key '2027' is rejected.
